Initial release of AI Caricature Portrait Generator.

- Generate caricature, cartoon, comic, or funny face portraits from text descriptions using the Neta AI image generation API.
- Supports various art styles and exaggerated features for personalized, humorous images.
- Includes options for output size (portrait, landscape, square, tall) and style inheritance via reference images.
- Requires a Neta API token for use.
- Ideal for gifts, social media, invitations, and custom art needs.
